description: This file contains unit tests for the AliasesAppender class, verifying its immutability, handling of environment variable scenarios, and correct appending of aliases configuration.

classes.name: AliasesAppenderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AliasesAppender, testing immutability, environment variable handling, and alias appending logic.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the staticJsonObject knownAliases with predefined alias mappings.

methods.name: initEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Sets up environment variables before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that AliasesAppender instances are immutable and their fields are safely copied and unmodifiable.

methods.name: appendAliasesConfigWhenSystemEnvironmentVariableIsNotSet
methods.description: Verifies that when the environment variable is unset, the Config remains unchanged.

methods.name: appendAliasesConfigWhenSystemEnvironmentVariableIsEmptyString
methods.description: Verifies that when the environment variable is an empty string, the Config remains unchanged.

methods.name: appendAliasesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the AliasesAppender correctly adds aliases to the configuration based on environment variables.
